integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from a bilinear normalization and exact unit-torus zero geometry. The standalone checker only corroborates explicit witnesses and finite grids; it is not used to infer the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Specific to equal-magnitude coefficients on the Cartesian four-point rectangle in cyclic product groups; no classification is asserted for arbitrary coefficient magnitudes, nonrectangular supports, or higher-dimensional boxes.
title: Phase-only Fourier-zero spectrum of a four-point rectangle on cyclic product groups
